title: A review record survives a clean merge of main, and a conflicted merge after a fix check takes another fix check
why: merge --review-record refuses --fix-check when the newest earlier record already has a Fix check line, so a lane that merges main after its fix pass (PR #1186, head e304a0033) cannot record the merge's fix check.
note: Owner ruling 14:07 CST Nov 10 (typed in the retrospective session, relayed by the coordinator 14:08 CST): "i agree on letting it survive a clean merge where batch ci sees the problem rather than asecond review i agree it shd be mechanical tooo". A review record stays valid when the new head differs from the reviewed head only by a clean merge of main (no conflict, the lane's own diff unchanged); the merge tool proves it mechanically (git merge-tree or range-diff). Any other difference keeps today's rule. Home: rewrite decision pr-review-record in place (reconcile its line 111 with lines 67-73), on #2563. Step fix-check-chain folds in here: a conflicted merge after a PASS fix check takes one more fix check. Waiting: #1186 (e304a0033), #1805 (bee580d0a), #2534 (b9eec43ec), #2465 (474752554), #2431 (53c93b41b), #2268 (5b038da96); all had conflicted merges or a fix, so each still owes its fix check record. Filed by triage 13:00 CST Nov 10. Refusal text: 'the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review record on this pull request, and that record must have no Fix check line' (decision pr-review-record). Done when a merge-from-main fix check records against the prior record's head, with a test red on main.
